Rugged tablets for the software your team already runs

Maintenance, asset management and inspection apps publish what they need from a device. We check those requirements against each Tuga tablet and say plainly which one fits, and where it does not.

Agility CMMS/EAM and the AgilityMobile app

Which Tuga rugged Android tablet fits SSG Insight's AgilityMobile app for maintenance engineers, with offline working and in-app QR scanning.

Our pick: Tuga A10, £449 Read
